about: Theodore S. Kypreos, an attorney with Jones Foster P.A. in West Palm Beach, Florida, helps clients address Estate & Trust Litigation situations. He also helps clients with Estate Planning & Probate, Alternative Dispute Resolution and Business Litigation concerns.
He received legal training from University of Florida Levin College of Law. He graduated from law school in 2002. Theodore Kypreos became licensed to practice law in 2002.
Theodore Kypreos was selected to Super Lawyers. The designation means that he is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. He was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2026.
